name: smwgraphics-rocky-rodent-downtown
title: Rocky Rodent - Downtown
description:
Background used on Downtown level (among others) on Rocky Rodent (SNES). It uses BG1, BG2 and BG3, and 47 colors (distributed on 3 rows) It also comes with the 3 palettes seen in the game.
Released on 2017 Summer C3
